name: Black Forest Labs FLUX API
description: Image generation and editing API from Black Forest Labs. Supports FLUX.2, FLUX.1, and Kontext model families for text-to-image generation, image editing, inpainting, and outpainting. All generation endpoints are asynchronous - submit a task and poll for results.
